Since the function is valid starting from $9$ A.M., we can conclude our interval is $[0,6].$

Applying the average value formula, we find that the average value of the function is

$$
\begin{aligned}{P}_{\text{avg}} & =\frac{1}{b-a}{\int }_{a}^{b}P(t)\,\text{d}t \\  & =\frac{1}{6-0}{\int }_{0}^{6}(150+10\operatorname{sin}⁡(\frac{\pi t}{3}))\text{d}t \\  & ={\frac{1}{6}(150t-\frac{30}{\pi }\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi \,t}{3}))|}_{0}^{6} \\  & =\frac{1}{6}[(150\cdot 6-\frac{30}{\pi }\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi \cdot 6}{3}))-(150\cdot 0-\frac{30}{\pi }\operatorname{cos}⁡(\frac{\pi \cdot 0}{3}))] \\  & =\frac{1}{6}[(900-\frac{30}{\pi }\operatorname{cos}⁡(2\pi ))-(-\frac{30}{\pi }\operatorname{cos}⁡(0))] \\  & =\frac{1}{6}[(900-\frac{30}{\pi }\cdot 1)+\frac{30}{\pi }\cdot 1] \\  & =\frac{1}{6}(900) \\  & =150.\end{aligned}
$$
